basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square illustrated audience card for the Matdo Check website's 'Where it's used' section. Create ONE polished drawing closely matching the provided Matdo Grade reference images in painterly style, palette and scale. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Soft hand-painted gouache texture, subtle dimensional shading, confident forest-green contours, rounded friendly objects, premium educational editorial still life. Solid warm cream #faf8ed background across the full square, a soft pale sage circular wash behind the central subject, restrained ochre-gold accents and two or three small dark-green botanical leaves framing the vignette. Central composition fills 75-85% of the square, objects fully visible with generous cream margins. Colors forest green #1d3b34, teal #1f6f63, sage #7c9a6f and muted gold. No text, words, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, borders or card frame. Keep object shapes clear at small sizes. Subject:
